concerns.text: FR-003 (JSON reports) and SC-003/SC-004 (runtime/memory) require saving raw reports with checksums and handling edge cases (no PRs, tool failures). Tasks T018 and T019 are marked [ ] (incomplete) and listed in the Analyze report as 'REJECTED' missing artifacts. Without these, T027 (alignment) and T032 (metrics) have no input data, breaking the pipeline.

FR-004 requires parsing PR comments to extract defect annotations and generating a candidate pool. T023 (heuristic extraction) and T023b (export/ingestion) are marked [ ] (incomplete) and flagged as 'REJECTED' in the Analyze report. This blocks the 'Union Ground Truth' construction (T028) required for FR-004 and SC-001.

SC-005 and Plan 'Ground Truth Construction' require a stratified random sample of ≥500 annotations independent of keywords. T024a (sampling logic) and T024b (export/ingestion) are marked [ ] (incomplete). T024b references `validated_random_samples.csv` which has no upstream task to generate the initial `random_review_candidates.csv`, creating a data flow gap.

T012 is an integration test for US1 marked [ ] (incomplete) and 'REJECTED' in the Analyze report. While tests are optional, the Analyze report flags a conflict where a rejected task is not re-implemented, yet US2 depends on US1 data. If T012 is intended to validate the pipeline before US2, its absence is a coverage gap for the 'Independent Test' requirement of US1.

Plan 'Project Structure' and Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) require `config.yaml` and git/venv initialization. T001b and T002b are marked [ ] (incomplete) and 'REJECTED'. T009 (env config) and T010 (checksum logic) depend on these artifacts. Their absence creates a foundational gap for the pipeline execution.

T012 is described as 'Integration test for Docker-based tool execution... (uses MOCKED tool output... does NOT satisfy FR-003 real execution)'. The tag `[X]` is missing (it is `[ ]`), but the Analyze report lists it as 'REJECTED'. The status is ambiguous: is it a missing task or a rejected one? Clarify if this task is required for coverage or if the 'Independent Test' is satisfied by T013-T017 alone.
